en.askTitle: Swap in your own start date, pay and cash and get a Berlin landing budget with the rental checks done
en.runTitle: Brazil to Berlin on a Blue Card: EUR 68,000 gross, starting work on 1 March 2027

fields.label: Nationality and current visa or work permission
fields.value: Brazilian; signed Berlin job offer on an EU Blue Card route

fields.label: Arrival and work-start dates
fields.value: Starts work 1 March 2027; arriving about 3 weeks earlier, alone

fields.label: Gross pay, tax and insurance assumptions, confirmed payday
fields.value: EUR 68,000 gross a year; tax class I

fields.label: Workplace and commute limit
fields.placeholder: e.g. office in Mitte, no more than 40 minutes each way

fields.label: Written rental quotes, fees and payment dates
fields.placeholder: e.g. a furnished room at EUR 1,100 a month, deposit due on signing

en.template: Help me plan my Berlin move using {status}, {dates}, {pay}, {cash}, {commute} and {quotes}. Separate landing cash from permanent-move cash, check registration support, flag missing costs and compare a salary-delay case. Ask before contacting anyone, booking or sharing my documents.

phases.title: Read the official registration, rental and payroll rules and gather dated housing examples
phases.note: Registration order, Blue Card work rights, deposit rules, rent index, furnished and long-term listings
phases.judgment: It would not turn thin evidence into price ranges. The eight furnished examples all come from one platform, and the long-term listings across five areas are labelled partial, not reliable neighbourhood ranges. Two deleted ads are marked as historical.

phases.title: Build the guide, with the net-pay calculation, cash budget and source list
phases.note: Registration order, week-by-week plan, 2026 net pay, landing cash
phases.judgment: The independent colleague confirmed the arithmetic (EUR 3,468.96 net a month under 2026 rules), then spotted a hidden assumption: the EUR 8,990 landing cash counts only two rent payments before payday. A third prepaid payment lifts the model to EUR 10,790.

phases.title: Final recheck of the numbers, plus desktop and phone layout tests

workers: Read official Berlin and German pages on address registration, work rights on arrival and renter protections
Collected dated listings for long-term 1- and 2-room flats and checked the official 2026 rent index
Collected eight dated furnished short-stay listings with monthly rent and each one’s registration policy
Recomputed net pay, the cash budget and the deposit sums on its own, and checked the guide’s claims against the sources

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的入职日期、薪资和现金，拿到一份做完租房核查的柏林落地预算
zh.runTitle: 从巴西到柏林，持蓝卡入职：税前年薪 6.8 万欧元，2027 年 3 月 1 日上班

fields.label: 国籍和现有签证工作许可
fields.value: 巴西籍；已拿到柏林工作录用，走欧盟蓝卡路径

fields.label: 抵达及入职日期
fields.value: 2027 年 3 月 1 日入职；提前约 3 周、独自抵达

fields.label: 税前年薪、税务保险假设和已确认发薪日
fields.value: 税前年薪 6.8 万欧元；税务一类

fields.label: 工作地点和通勤上限
fields.placeholder: 例如：公司在 Mitte，单程通勤不超过 40 分钟

fields.label: 书面租房报价、费用和付款日
fields.placeholder: 例如：带家具单间月租 1,100 欧元，签约时付押金

zh.template: 请根据{status}、{dates}、{pay}、{cash}、{commute}以及{quotes}，帮我规划柏林搬迁。分开计算落地和长期搬家现金，检查住址登记支持，标出遗漏费用，并比较工资延迟情形。联系任何人、预订或分享文件前先征求我同意。

phases.title: 阅读官方登记、租房和工资税规则，收集标日期的租房例子
phases.note: 登记顺序、蓝卡工作权利、押金规则、租金指数、短租与长租房源
phases.judgment: 证据单薄时，它没有硬凑价格区间。8 个带家具的例子都来自同一个平台，五个区域的长租房源只标为“部分”，不当作可靠的区域行情；两条已删除的广告也标明是历史信息。

phases.title: 写出指南，附税后工资计算、现金预算和来源清单
phases.note: 登记顺序、逐周清单、2026 年税后工资、落地现金
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事确认了算术（按 2026 年规则，税后月薪 3,468.96 欧元），又发现一个隐含假设：8,990 欧元落地现金只算了发薪前的两期房租。若再预付第三期，模型会升到 10,790 欧元。

phases.title: 最后复算数字，并测试桌面和手机版式

workers: 阅读柏林和德国官方页面：住址登记、抵达后的工作权利、租客保护
收集标日期的长租一居、两居房源，并核对 2026 年官方租金指数
收集 8 个标日期的带家具短租房源，记下月租和各自的住址登记政策
独立重算税后工资、现金预算和押金，并对照来源核查指南里的说法
